title: Prism's Amethyst End
description: Recolors End-related items and blocks into a purple / amethyst theme including End portals, Ender eyes and ender pearls.
body:
![Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f336e8be4d6905640900eb1f9139852a58d0746f.png)
## INFORMATION
**This recourse pack focuses on recoloring specific End elements, the _end portal_, _ender eye_ and _ender pearl_ textures have been modified from their original green colors to a _amethyst_ theme.**
